user.title: Elli Charger Setup
user.description:
Elli requires a browser sign-in. The last step of it redirects to the Elli iOS app, which your browser cannot open, so the address never appears in the address bar and has to be read from the developer tools.

**Use a desktop browser** (Chrome, Edge or Firefox). This cannot be done on a phone.

1. Open the [Elli sign-in page]({authorization_url}) in a **new tab**.
2. In that new tab press **F12** to open the developer tools, and switch to the **Console** tab.
3. Now sign in.
4. The page will appear to do nothing. In the console an error appears that contains a link starting with `com.elli.ios.emsp://`.
5. Copy that link **completely**, including `com.elli.ios.emsp://` and everything after the `?`, and paste it below.

If the console stays empty, use the **Network** tab instead: tick **Preserve log**, sign in again, select the last entry and copy the `Location` value from its response headers.

Leave this dialog open while you do it. The link belongs to this dialog only and is valid just for a few moments.
